page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.13xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 52 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of approximately 1.85 GB per vCPU.

This instance does not include any bundled local storage, requiring the attachment of external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps. The instance does not feature integrated GPU hardware accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its low memory-to-CPU ratio, the ecs.c6t.13xlarge is designed for compute-heavy workloads that do not demand massive memory footprints. This hardware profile offers qualitative cost efficiency for parallel processing tasks, batch processing, and web serving workloads where CPU utilization is the primary bottleneck rather than memory capacity or local storage speed.
